title: AL Language Server Settings
description: Configuration for the AL Language Server (al-lsp). In Zed these keys live inside "lsp": { "al-lsp": { "settings": { ... } } } in settings.json. They control analysis, diagnostics, completions, symbol resolution, scaffolding, and debugging.

al.enableCodeAnalysis.description: Enable semantic code analysis via the .NET CodeAnalysis bridge. Provides compiler-level diagnostics (permissions, event restrictions, type errors).

al.backgroundCodeAnalysis.description: Run code analysis in the background continuously. Disable to only run on explicit compile.

al.diagnosticsScope.description: Scope for diagnostics. 'project' lints all .al files; 'openFiles' only lints open tabs. Default: project (our lint is fast enough).

al.diagnosticsTrigger.description: When to run diagnostics. 'continuous' runs on every change (debounced); 'onSave' only on file save.

al.codeAnalyzers.description: Which code analyzers to run. Standard: CodeCop, AppSourceCop, UICop, PerTenantCop. Add custom DLL paths for third-party analyzers like BusinessCentral.LinterCop.

al.enableExternalRulesets.description: Enable external rulesets (.ruleset.json files) for custom diagnostic severity overrides.

al.ruleSetPath.description: Path to a .ruleset.json file for custom diagnostic severity overrides.

al.assemblyProbingPaths.description: Additional assembly probing paths for CodeAnalysis DLLs and custom analyzers.

al.outputAnalyzerStatistics.description: Output analyzer performance statistics in diagnostics.

al.enableCodeActions.description: Enable code actions (quick fixes, refactorings, source actions).

al.inlayHints.parameterNames.description: Show parameter name hints at function call sites.

al.inlayHints.returnTypes.description: Show return type hints on procedure declarations.

al.enableNativeLint.description: Enable native AL lint and semantic rules: file-local AL-NL001/2, resolved transaction-stack AL-NL003/4, and project/symbol AL-NC001-006 diagnostics. The optional Microsoft CodeAnalysis bridge remains additive for exact analyzer compatibility.

al.nativeLintRules.description: Per-rule enable/disable overrides for native lint rules. Key is a rule code (for example AL-NL003 or AL-NC005). Only takes effect when al.enableNativeLint is true.

al.packageCachePath.description: Custom path for the symbol package cache. Default: <project>/.alpackages/

al.appLocalFolderPaths.description: Additional local folders containing .app files to index for symbols, beyond the package cache.

al.nugetFeeds.description: Custom public NuGet v3 feeds to resolve symbol packages from, tried before the built-in Microsoft feeds. Each entry: {"name": string, "url": string (v3 index URL)}.

al.useOnlyCustomFeeds.description: When true, ONLY the feeds in al.nugetFeeds are used; the built-in public Microsoft feeds (MSSymbols, AppSourceSymbols, BCPublic) are skipped.

al.symbolsCountryRegion.description: Country/region code for localized BC symbol packages (e.g. 'us', 'gb', 'au').

al.compilationOptions.description: Additional command-line options passed to the AL compiler (alc).

al.useOfficialCompiler.description: Escape hatch: compile via Microsoft's `dotnet alc` subprocess instead of the pure-Rust verified `.app` pipeline. The native default runs syntax, project/dependency, declaration, declared-symbol binding, and package-integrity checks with structured diagnostics and no `alc` or C# bridge. Set this to `true` when exact Microsoft expression/type semantics, analyzers, or compatibility behaviour are required.

al.maxDocumentSizeBytes.description: Optional per-document size cap, in bytes. When set, the server refuses to ingest a single document larger than this (keeping huge files out of the in-memory store). null (default) means no cap.

al.useOfficialLsp.description: Escape hatch: delegate the session to Microsoft's official AL Language Server (al-lsp --official-lsp), instead of this project's native server. Requires ALTool v17+ on the machine. An explicit binary.arguments override takes precedence over this setting.

al.useOfficialDap.description: Escape hatch: use Microsoft's EditorServices.Host debug-adapter proxy (al-lsp --dap-legacy) instead of this project's native BC debug adapter. Native debugging is the default; there is no automatic fallback. Requires the AL toolchain (ALTool) on the machine.
